title: Welcome to My Blog
content:
This is my first blog post. Stay tuned for posts on a wide variety of topics.

I mainly plan to use this space to share thoughts that don't fit neatly into academic papers — work in progress, responses to things I've read, and the occasional reflection on teaching and research. I also want to share what I'm working on outside of academic life, including everything from recipes and movie recommendations to astronomy and electronics projects. I don't know how often I will post, so no promises other than this: Whatever I post was — at the very least — interesting to me.
